title: Quasi-coherent derived objects are closed under coproducts
statement: For every scheme X and set I, the quasi-coherent cohomology property is closed under colimits of shape Discrete I in the ambient derived category.

proof.text: Unpack an arbitrary discrete colimit presentation p of Y whose diagram objects have quasi-coherent cohomology. Put E(i) = p.diag.obj(Discrete.mk i); choose complex representatives using Q.objPreimage and Q.objObjPreimageIso. Apply derivedAmbientDirectSums to obtain the colimit cofan c and its canonical cohomology comparison in every integer degree.

For each integer q, all H^q(E(i)) are quasi-coherent by p.prop_diag_obj. Apply the already proved source-library arbitrary coproduct theorem isQuasicoherent_sigma to conclude that their coproduct is quasi-coherent. No expression as a filtered colimit of finite sums is needed.

Precompose p.cocone with the inverse of Discrete.natIsoFunctor to obtain a colimit cofan c-prime for E. Uniqueness of colimits gives an isomorphism c.pt to Y. The canonical comparison isomorphism from the coproduct of the H^q(E(i)) to H^q(c.pt), followed by homology of this colimit-uniqueness isomorphism, gives an isomorphism to H^q(Y). Transport quasi-coherence along it. This proves all degrees and hence the object-property closure, including an empty index set.

lean.statement: theorem schemeDerivedQCohClosedUnderCoproducts (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] (I : Type u) : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
